eyebrow: A Kubernetes identity means nothing to the cloud, on its own

steps.label: Long-lived
steps.sub: sits in a Secret until someone rotates it

steps.label: Manual rotation
steps.sub: easy to forget, easy to leak

code:
az aks update -g northbridge-rg -n northbridge-aks \
  --enable-oidc-issuer --enable-workload-identity

az federatedidentity credential create \
  --name catalog-sync-federated \
  --identity-name catalog-sync-identity \
  --subject system:serviceaccount:catalog:catalog-sync
caption: The ServiceAccount's own token proves identity to Azure AD — no client secret stored anywhere.

eyebrow: EKS: IAM Roles for Service Accounts
code:
eksctl create iamserviceaccount \
  --cluster northbridge-eks \
  --namespace fulfillment \
  --name fulfillment-sync \
  --attach-policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess \
  --approve
caption: One command creates the IAM role, trusts it to the cluster's OIDC provider, and annotates the ServiceAccount.
